customer_question: We want to cancel our Pro plan at the end of the month, but we may come back later. Will our workflows and connectors be kept?
resolution: Explained that cancelling stops all further charges and deletes workspace data 30 days after cancellation, so workflows and connectors would not be kept. Suggested downgrading to the Free plan instead: the downgrade takes effect on the next billing day, workflows are kept, and Free limits apply (500 workflow runs per month, 1 seat, 7-day run history). The customer chose to downgrade.
